'''Zara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Zara was one of the [[Newcomer]]s, the second wave of colonists to settle on Nam Chorios, and she lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hweg Shul]] with [[Zara's father|her father]] and [[Zara's son|her son]]. In [[44 ABY]], the entity [[Abeloth]] journeyed to Nam Chorios and her use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] caused a large [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]] to develop, which swept through Hweg Shul and blew Zara's house away, with Zara and her family inside. However, Zara was rescued by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], while her father and son were saved by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]].
